backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the backend, defining data types and endpoints for branding, homepage config, user profiles, products, shopping carts, and shop details, with admin access control enforced via AccessControl mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that BulkProductUpload.tsx was updated to auto-select shape-specific description templates (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale, or Default) based on the product's shape field, with high confidence tied to test REQ-139.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key features of each component, page, and hook in the application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, secondary, etc.) used throughout the UI.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the frontend app titled 'Original Creations Hub', mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (marketplace, dashboard, checkout, payment, legal, ocarina studio), wraps the app in a ThemeProvider, and applies dynamic branding.
frontend/src/components/BrandingSettings: Admin form component for updating site branding including site name, logo, and favicon uploads with preview, progress tracking, and validation before submitting via the updateBranding mutation.
frontend/src/components/BulkProductUploa: Bulk product upload component that auto-selects shape-specific description templates (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale → matching template; other/blank → Default) on shape field change, while preserving manually edited descriptions, and supports batch image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/DescriptionTempl: A dialog component for creating or editing description templates, with name and content fields, using mutation hooks to save changes and toast notifications for feedback.
A card-based manager component that lists all description templates with options to create, edit, or delete them, using confirmation dialogs and the DescriptionTemplateEditor for create/edit flows.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A site footer component displaying branding, legal links, and contact email fetched from shop details, with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/HomepageSettings: An admin settings card for customizing the homepage hero section, allowing updates to the hero motto, promotional text, and hero image with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component providing a sticky header with navigation links, cart count badge, login/logout, admin dashboard link, and a footer, with responsive mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/OcarinaPanel.tsx: An interactive ocarina instrument panel that renders scale-themed note buttons for a given ocarina scale, playing audio tones on press with visual active-note feedback.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSettingsT: Admin tab component for managing discount codes (create/edit/delete) and payment settings including pro app URL and bonus item configuration, using React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product in a card layout with image, name, category, price, and an 'Add to Basket' button that triggers the addToCart mutation.
frontend/src/components/ProductDetailVie: Modal dialog showing full product details (image, description, price, policies) with 'Add to Basket' and 'Buy Now' action buttons.
frontend/src/components/ProductManagemen: Admin table for viewing, filtering, and inline-editing products including name, description, price, shape, category, and image upload, with bulk update and inventory count controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Stub component for a profile setup modal that is currently disabled and renders nothing.
frontend/src/components/ShopDetailsSetti: Settings form for managing shop details such as name, contact info, address, opening hours, and company details, with load and save functionality via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx: Admin form for configuring Stripe payment integration by entering a secret key and allowed countries, with status display and a delete configuration option.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicBranding.ts: Custom hook that fetches branding configuration and dynamically updates the document title and favicon based on the retrieved settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider component, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for the application, covering data fetching and mutations for products, user profiles, cart, branding, shop settings, discount codes, and more via the ICP backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, defines CSS custom properties for a warm terracotta/earthy light and dark color theme, and imports Google Fonts for an artisan aesthetic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and the InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page component that displays cart or buy-now items, supports promo code validation with discount calculation, and initiates a Stripe checkout session.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that shows store statistics (product count, inventory value, etc.) and provides tabbed management interfaces for products, branding, shop settings, and payment configuration.
frontend/src/pages/Marketplace.tsx: Main marketplace page displaying products with a hero section, search input, and filters for sort order, shape, and category. Fetches products via custom hooks and renders them as ProductCard components with a detail view modal.
frontend/src/pages/OcarinaStudio.tsx: Ocarina Studio page that lists products as studio cards, each allowing users to play a demo audio sample or open an interactive OcarinaPanel for the product's musical scale.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Simple payment failure page showing an error message with buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that clears the cart, displays order confirmation, and conditionally shows a Pro Ocarina Learning App link and bonus item details from payment settings.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Static privacy policy page covering data collection, usage, shipping, digital products, no-returns policy, payment processing, and user rights.
frontend/src/pages/ShoppingBasket.tsx: Shopping basket page that displays cart items with quantity controls and removal, shows the total price, and provides a checkout navigation button.
frontend/src/pages/Terms.tsx: Renders the Terms & Conditions page for Original Creations Hub, covering sections on products, pricing, shipping, returns, digital inclusions, IP, and liability using a Card layout.
frontend/src/utils/ocarinaSynth.ts: Web Audio API utility that defines ocarina scale/note frequency mappings and provides a `playNote` function that synthesizes ocarina-like tones using blended oscillators with ADSR envelope shaping.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, Inter/Crimson Pro fonts, border radii, box shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 57) describing the Artisan Hub marketplace architecture, existing features, known issues, and high-level design decisions for a sole-trader storefront with Stripe payments and bulk image upload.
